verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs include a 'Test Data' / 'Datos de prueba' section paired with 'Moving to Production', and an Apple Pay sandbox testing page, so a first-party test environment with test data exists. The evidence is only page titles, with no detail on how far the sandbox mirrors production or which scenarios the test data covers. Missing for 10: documented sandbox parity with production, test cards for declines and other failure scenarios, dispute/chargeback simulation, coverage across the full payment flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes
